paraphrase: Under the esse criterion every candidate is concrete (has esse in re) or abstract (lacks esse in re), and none is both: the criterion draws an exact line with no borderline cases. It says nothing about which candidates have esse in re, and nothing about rival criteria of concreteness.
note: Owner (#1103, 2026-11-06): 'We have these words in order to draw a line. The same way we have words like dead and alive, inside or outside.' Derived from STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE by CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-ESSE-DICHOTOMY.
